item.title: Topological photonics in nanoscaled systems with far field radiation and polarization singularities
item.description: arXiv:2508.20487v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topology is a powerful framework for controlling and manipulating light, minimizing detrimental perturbations on the photonic properties. Combining nanophotonics with topological concepts presents opportunities for both fundamental physics and technological applications.
